profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary:
Currently I'm the tech lead of a team at Amazon which is redesigning the Amazon phone app's video experience to focus on performance and experimentation. My team's projects has contributed to a projected yearly revenue increase of $100+ million and serves tens of millions of customers a day.

I love to learn, tinker and dive into new technology. I love learning languages, seeing how they approach problems, and how I can apply it back to my work. I have experience or experimented with most well known languages, from Java and Typescript to Lisp and F# (even esoteric ones like brainf*ck), and everything in-between.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
I am the tech lead of a team of 8 engineers which is redesigning the Amazon phone app’s video/image player in React Native to focus on performance and rapid experimentation. I launched the first iteration in one month, amid a global pandemic, with 94% unit test code coverage and no leaked bugs or errors. My team's projects has contributed to a projected yearly revenue increase of $100+ million and serves tens of millions of customers a day.

I Led cross-org team of 10 to redesign the Amazon app's shoppable livestreams to be native and performant, dropping stream latency from 10 to 2 seconds

I personally and autonomously integrated Kotlin into the Amazon Android app, when it was thought impossible due to Amazon’s proprietary build system. Afterwards, I worked with engineers and managers on other teams to formulate a migration plan, resulting in each team within my org pushing Kotlin code to production.

Leveraging my Android build knowledge, I autonomously drove a campaign to reduce the Amazon Android phone app’s build times, resulting in a drop of 52-82% (saving 13+ min per build). To have my recommendations adopted app-wide, I had to build consensus across 4 teams in separate orgs.

While working on the Amazon Shopping FireTV app, I autonomously drove Android build tools investigation from hackathon project to release, resulting in local build times dropping by 80%, CI pipeline build times dropping by 70% (1 hour to 12 min) and app size dropping by 40%.

Owned Detail Page development (⅓ of the app) of the Amazon Shopping FireTV (Android) app. Leading a junior engineer to deliver the most complicated portion of the app, successfully hitting the org’s goal of launching in 6 months.

Owned Detail Page development (⅓ of the app) of the Amazon Shopping tvOS (iOS based) app.

Led re-architecting of tvOS and FireTV apps to integrate React Native, allowing for rapid development and deployment of experiments.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Led the design and development of a psychological assessment engine for Android, iOS, and Windows using C#, Xamarin, and the Agile methodology

Researched cross-platform mobile development solutions such as PhoneGap, Cordova, Xamarin, Unity 2D, and C++ shared libraries by creating prototypes and sharing findings with management to determine the most suitable approach to cross-platform development

Reduced server-side PDF report generation from 25 seconds to 0.5 seconds by redesigning the legacy system to follow MVC and OOD, resulting in reduced customer wait time

Brought legacy PDF report generation system under continuous integration and unit testing suites, allowing for more thorough and quicker QA cycles

Simplified a major product development process by researching and establishing a new language translation library that can be used across projects and platforms, saving the company many hours of inter-team and external contractor coordination

Initiated the practice of code reviews as part of helping lead the company's move to Scrum

Development of web applications, web services, backend services, desktop applications,
and mobile applications using C#, .NET, and SQL

positions.title: Software Tools Developer
positions.description:
Created a memory visualization tool for new hearing aid hardware using Java, allowing other software engineers to debug memory allocations

Developed Python scripts to generate hardware register information for the Integrated Development Environment (IDE)

Researched and prototyped a new tool chain to create firmware images for Digital Signal Processing (DSP) systems, using GNU tools rather than proprietary ones

Ported Java software used to flash firmware images to C# and Python

NSERC grant received for “Memory visualization tools for multi-processor digital signal processing systems with shared memory” while at ON Semiconductor.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Development of a replacement for existing payroll cheque reconciliation program using Visual BASIC, SQL and ASP.net, as part of a team. Updated proprietary Social Worker Scheduling Tool to work with newer versions of Microsoft Outlook.  Implemented new jquery and javascript features in the Tech Support ticket system.

positions.title: Web Design Consultant
positions.description: Design, development and presentation of website redesign concepts in Adobe Photoshop CS and programming of selected design in Adobe Dreamweaver CS.
